title: Ironing out oxygen instability - Nature Energy
text:
Oxygen redox in layered-oxide cathodes could facilitate the development of high-energy sodium-ion batteries, but poor reversibility has limited its practical application. Now, an iron-mediated redox strategy offers a pathway to substantially improving oxygen-redox reversibility.
